protocol: walk-forward per kompetisi piala dicerminkan dari scripts/backtest-cup-offsets.ts (fit domestik + δ + G/HA hanya dari data sebelum musim uji); lengan offset-only = predictMatch existing; lengan blend = prior tertransformasi δ di-blend telemetri/form last-6 (κ×2, lib/quant/cup-form-blend.ts) pada populasi ter-rate yang IDENTIK; telemetri/form cutoff = tanggal laga (strictly-before, konvensi lab); matriks blend via konvensi matrixFromLamMu lab (rho=0, maxGoals=10); naive = base rate kandang/tandang latih kompetisi
adoption_rule: Adopt the blend ONLY if ALL three hold on the identical rated population: (i) pooled held-out log-loss (1X2, metricsOf) of blend < offset-only; (ii) pooled calibration slope does not worsen: |slope_blend − 1| ≤ |slope_offset − 1|; (iii) high-band honesty does not degrade overall: pooled over all 16 matrix candidates with stated prob ≥ 0.55 (lab BANDS 55–60 … 85+), the n-weighted gap (hitRate − meanProb) of blend ≥ gap of offset-only.

config.telemetrySource: team_match_logs source='sportmonks', competition_id via matches join (cerminan parlay-lab)
config.formSource: matches finished sm:% per tim (cerminan parlay-lab formGoals)
config.priorSource: fit domestik lipatan (fitDomesticFold) tertransformasi δ lipatan (fitOffsets)

reproductionCheck.note: nTest identik dengan referensi di semua kompetisi.
